title: Agno & Mastra
motto: Agno (Python) and Mastra (TypeScript) are the 2026 production-runtime pairing. Agno aims at microsecond agent instantiation and stateless FastAPI backends. Mastra ships agents, tools, workflows, unified model routing, and composite storage on the Vercel AI SDK substrate.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Agno (Python) and Mastra (TypeScript) are the 2026 production-runtime pairing. Agno aims at microsecond agent instantiation and stateless FastAPI backends. Mastra ships agents, tools, workflows, unified model routing, and composite storage on the Vercel AI SDK substrate.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI are framework-heavy. Teams that want "just the agent loop, fast, in my runtime" reach for Agno (Python) or Mastra (TypeScript). Both trade some of the framework-owned primitives for raw speed and a tighter fit to the surrounding stack.
